title: hibiscus phlomidifolius
intro: Hibiscus phlomidifolius, commonly known as the 'Red Cotton Ball Tree', is a species of flowering plant in the mallow family, Malvaceae. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and lowering blood pressure due to its ability to act as a natural diuretic. The therapeutic actions of Hibiscus phlomidifolius are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including anthocyanins, flavonoids, and saponins, which exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Research has also identified other bioactive constituents, including polyphenols and alkaloids, contributing to its medicinal properties.
